Generate Univariate Intercept Manifest

Generate the dense univariate-with-intercept experiment manifest.

The observed patients are reused row by row from results/wide_results.csv so the generalized with-intercept formulation can be compared with the historical no-intercept scan on exactly the same observations. The historical mu_Y values are translated from a zero-centered structural-noise mean to the intercept-aware center at 12.

slurm.generate_parameter_file_univariate_intercept.generate_univariate_intercept_manifest(source_file=PosixPath('results/wide_results.csv'), parameters_file=PosixPath('slurm/tmp/parameters_univariate_intercept_wide.txt'), replicates=None, deviations=None, fixed_rng_seed=4, design_file=None)[source]

Write an extensible manifest for the dense univariate intercept scan.

Parameters:

  • source_file (str or pathlib.Path) – Historical wide-results CSV.

  • parameters_file (str or pathlib.Path) – Output manifest.

  • replicates (sequence of int or None) – Per-cell archived patient IDs.

  • deviations (sequence of int or None) – Scan-step offsets.

  • fixed_rng_seed (int) – Base random seed.

  • design_file (str or pathlib.Path or None) – JSON sidecar path.

Returns:

Generated manifest path.

Return type:

pathlib.Path
